purpose: Teach: 司祭/殿下/教皇/暗黒/破滅/連行/暴落/批准

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、地元の司祭にお祭りで挨拶しろ
lines.en: Make contact with the local priest at the festival. We need to represent ourselves there.
lines.style: Measured, direct command. Voice steady and even—no room for negotiation. Clear articulation on the key verbs. Brief pause between thoughts to let each instruction land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外殿下御用達ブランドを目指します
lines.en: Understood. We're positioning ourselves as a purveyor to international clientele.
lines.style: Respectful deference but not obsequious. Professional clarity—he's reporting back what he understood. Even pace, each clause deliberate. A touch of quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、教皇庁関連の式典にも参加しろ
lines.en: We'll also be participating in the Vatican-affiliated ceremonies. Make sure that's handled.
lines.style: Same measured authority as the first directive. Slightly slower on 'Vatican-affiliated' to ensure weight. Calm assumption of execution—this isn't a request for permission.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。暗黒時代の和テイスト商品、好評です
lines.en: Got it. The wa-influenced products from the medieval-inspired line have been selling well.
lines.style: Straightforward status report. Confident but not boastful. Slightly quicker pace than the boss to signal subordinate energy. Small lift of satisfaction on 'selling well'—good news delivered without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の破滅を防ぐべく改革を進めろ
lines.en: Push forward with reforms to prevent industry collapse. This is our responsibility.
lines.style: Firmer than previous directives—moral weight underneath. 'Collapse' lands with emphasis. Pause before 'responsibility' to underscore the gravity. Voice doesn't rise, but conviction deepens.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違法業者の連行を警察に通報しました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already reported the illegal operators to the police for arrest.
lines.style: Quick, efficient reporting. Pride of action without self-congratulation. Clipped pace—he's already done it, presenting it as fact. Respectful close on 'sir'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、株価の暴落リスクに備えよ
lines.en: Prepare the company for potential stock volatility. We need contingency plans in place.
lines.style: Clinical precision. 'Volatility' enunciated clearly—this is financial risk, not drama. Flat, realistic tone. No alarm, no comfort—just the facts of what needs doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引の批准は社長決裁です
lines.en: Understood. Any new contracts will require your personal sign-off as president.
lines.style: Closing acknowledgment. Professional respect—he's clarifying chain of command. Steady, no rush. Final word on 'president' carries the formality of protocol closing.
